turns.text: Hey Lloyd, did the package with the new cooling paste arrive?
Yes, tracking shows it was delivered to your front porch around 2 PM today.
Great. I might start re-pasting the GPU tomorrow. By the way, I was reading up on NVIDIA's roadmap. They claim Blackwell Ultra has ~1.4x higher per-GPU performance than GB200 NVL72.
That's a significant bump for a mid-cycle refresh. It suggests they are squeezing more out of the architecture before the next major node.
Yeah, exactly. I'm just trying to figure out if it's worth waiting for or if I should buy the H100 now. The weather is looking nice tomorrow, perfect for working in the garage.
If the forecast holds, that sounds like a good day for hardware work. The H100 is a safe bet, but Blackwell's density might be interesting for future-proofing.
True. I'll think about it over dinner. Any recommendations for a good pasta place nearby?
There's a new Italian spot on 5th called 'Basilico' that has decent reviews.
Lloyd, I finally got the cooling paste application done. The temps are down by 5 degrees.
That's a solid improvement. Did you use the thermal pads correctly?
Yes, carefully. I also went back to reading those NVIDIA specs. It turns out Blackwell Ultra is supposed to have ~5x higher per-GPU performance than the previous generation.
Wow, 5x is massive. That would drastically change training timelines for large models.
Exactly. It makes me question if I should have waited. But I already bought the parts for the current build. The weather is turning rainy again, so I'm stuck inside coding.
Rainy days are good for coding. At least the current build will be ready when you need it.
I guess so. My neighbor's dog is barking again. Do you know any white noise apps that are actually free?
Try 'MyNoise' or 'Rainy Mood'. Both have free tiers that work well.
